issue.title: Bob Mac Capture health badge from bob tick's receipt and tick-finished notification

task_type_fields.proposal:
Give Bob Mac Capture a small health badge for the Mac's background work. `bob tick` (epic bob-cli-nb, docs/tick.md) already writes a per-host receipt at `$XDG_STATE_HOME/bob-cli/tick/last.json` after every locked run and, on macOS, posts the Darwin notification `org.bobs.bob.tick-finished`. The badge would observe that notification and surface a failed or stale tick (exit_code != 0, a step whose last_success_at is old, or no receipt for longer than expected) without polling the vault.

Per decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client, the app must not parse the receipt's semantics itself if bob can serve them: prefer a bob-served read (for example `bob tick -s -f json`, which prints the same per-step shape with mode: status) over reading last.json directly, and coordinate any new contract across bob-cli and bob-mac-capture. Decide the badge's placement and states with Bryan.

Proposed by bob-cli-nb.5 note #3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), recorded by the bob-cli-nb land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-nb plan put any Mac Capture UI out of scope: the epic shipped the receipt and the notification so a future badge needs no new protocol, but the badge itself is a separate bob-mac-capture feature needing its own design.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nb.5 proposed this follow-up: bob tick now emits a receipt and a Darwin notification so a Mac Capture badge can show background-work health, but no client consumes them yet.
